course.title: GIS and Remote Sensing
course.department: Department of Urban and Regional Planning

content.value: Suppose you have a paper mouza map of Khulna City. You need to link proposed plans to the mouza map for implementing the priority projects. Is it necessary to georeference the paper map before performing any analysis? If so, describe the process. If not, explain why.
